approval.note: Native withdrawal quotation with source/runtime identity and block-pinned read adapter. Does not guarantee investor execution, market price or exclusivity of internal pricing.

runtime.note: Current-block native Curve withdrawal path; units, balances, code identity, available pause/blacklist checks and final block hash verified before LIVE.

valuation.formula: USDT per 1 LP = pool.calc_withdraw_one_coin(10^LPDecimals, USDTIndex) / 10^USDTDecimals. The verified pool implementation calculates the native single-coin redemption using its invariant, balances, rates and withdrawal fees; no LP exchange-market quote is used.
valuation.methodology: Native pool calculation of USDT received by redeeming exactly 1 LP via a single-coin withdrawal, using the selected USDT coin index. No exchange quotation for the LP token or assumed USD peg.

inputParameters.name: i
inputParameters.meaning: Native USDT index confirmed by coins(uint256)

limitations: Single-coin redemption quotation, including protocol withdrawal fees and current pool imbalance; not an LP market quote or guaranteed execution price.
A quote for one LP cannot be multiplied into guaranteed full-supply liquidation proceeds.
The native invariant algorithm was source-reviewed, not independently reimplemented.
No evidence of exclusively internal pricing or aggregator rejection.
Pool assets may include other stablecoins or vault receipts; their risks and protocol rate mechanisms affect the redemption quotation.
LIVE is a current native withdrawal quotation with code, units, coin and cash checks; actual investor execution and full-supply liquidation are not guaranteed.

value.note: Native redemption quote for exactly one whole LP token. Dated reference; not an automatically refreshed price.
